questions.question: Verify the dates and exact appointments at the Collège des Quatre-Nations and Collège de France, the claim of friendship with Newton and the priority of the U-tube manometer.

localizations.source: Verify the dates and exact appointments at the Collège des Quatre-Nations and Collège de France, the claim of friendship with Newton and the priority of the U-tube manometer.
localizations.ru: Сверить даты и точные должности в Коллеже Четырёх Наций и Коллеж де Франс, а также формулировку «друг Ньютона» и приоритет U-образного манометра.

questions.resolution: The appointments, correspondence and date of the manometer have been corrected from CTHS, the Académie des sciences and the Academy memoir for 1705. https://cths.fr/an/savant.php?id=112959 ; https://www.academie-sciences.fr/en/node/1850

questions.resolution: The statement now separates the midpoint result, which also holds in degenerate cases, from the parallelism claim, for which nonzero diagonals are explicit. The absence of an original-post URL does not affect the mathematics.
